in_arabic.name: فرليم
in_arabic.long_meaning: فرليم هو اسم عربي يعني الفرح والسرور والبهجة، ويعود أصوله إلى الجذور العربية القديمة، ويعبر عن الفرح والابتهاج الذي يشعر به الإنسان عند ولادة طفل جديد، وله أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية حيث يرتبط بالفرح والسرور الذي يشعر به المسلمون عند ولادة الأبناء

in_urdu.name: فرلیم
in_urdu.long_meaning: فرلیم ایک عربی نام ہے جو خوشی اور سکون کے معنی میں آتا ہے، اور اس کی جڑیں قدیم عربی زبان سے ملتی ہیں، اور یہ نام اسلام میں بہت اہم ہے کیونکہ یہ خوشی اور سکون کے ساتھ منسلک ہے جو مسلم والدین کو اپنے بچوں کی پیدائش پر محسوس ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: फ़रलीम
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़रलीम एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ खुशी और संतुष्टि है, और इसकी जड़ें प्राचीन अरबी भाषा में हैं, और यह नाम इस्लाम में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि यह खुशी और संतुष्टि से जुड़ा हुआ है जो मुस्लिम माता-पिता को अपने बच्चों के जन्म पर महसूस होता है

in_pashto.name: فرلیم

in_english.name: Farleem
in_english.long_meaning: Farleem is an Arabic name that means joy and tranquility, and its roots go back to ancient Arabic language, and it has great significance in Islamic culture as it is associated with the joy and tranquility felt by Muslim parents at the birth of their children, and is considered a blessing from Allah

data.cultural_impact: The name Farleem, in Islamic context, signifies the notion of hope, light, and joy. Often, people with this name are perceived to be the bearers of good news and positive vibes. In numerous Islamic cultures, the name is significant, as it relates to the spiritual light brought by Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) to the world. Furthermore, it is an homage to the belief in the grace of Allah (swt) and the guidance and illumination He provides.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Farleem carries a deep spiritual meaning in Islamic traditions. It signifies the divine light of Allah and the spiritual enlightenment that comes with following the teachings of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). It represents the ultimate goal of every believer to seek guidance from Allah and to become a beacon of light in the world. The name Farleem is a constant reminder to spread joy and positivity, fostering a connection with the Creator and spreading the message of love and compassion.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Bright, illuminating" symbolizes Bringer of light, illumination and joy. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Farleem serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of bright, illuminating.
